B: Inhibition of mitochondrial complex I leading to reduced ATP and AMPK activation
C: Suppression of PDAC cell proliferation and enhanced sensitivity to gemcitabine
statement: Metformin inhibits mitochondrial complex I in PDAC cells, activating AMPK and suppressing proliferation while sensitizing tumors to gemcitabine.

B: Inhibition of the mevalonate pathway reducing prenylation of RAS proteins
C: Decreased PDAC tumor growth and metastasis
statement: Atorvastatin inhibits the mevalonate pathway, reducing RAS prenylation and thereby decreasing PDAC tumor growth and metastasis.

B: Inhibition of autophagy flux and lysosomal acidification
C: Enhanced efficacy of standard chemotherapy in PDAC
statement: Chloroquine blocks autophagy flux and lysosomal acidification, enhancing the efficacy of standard chemotherapy in PDAC.

B: Reduction of hyaluronan production and collagen cross-linking in the tumor microenvironment
C: Improved vascular perfusion and delivery of nanotherapeutics in PDAC
statement: Losartan reduces hyaluronan production and collagen cross-linking in the TME, improving vascular perfusion and nanotherapeutic delivery in PDAC.

B: Inhibition of PAK1 kinase and induction of immunogenic cell death
C: Suppression of PDAC tumor growth and enhanced anti-tumor immunity
statement: Ivermectin inhibits PAK1 kinase and induces immunogenic cell death, suppressing PDAC tumor growth and enhancing anti-tumor immunity.

B: Inhibition of Wnt/β-catenin and STAT3 signaling pathways
C: Reversal of epithelial-mesenchymal transition and reduced PDAC metastasis
statement: Niclosamide inhibits Wnt/β-catenin and STAT3 signaling, reversing EMT and reducing PDAC metastasis.

B: Chelation of intracellular copper and inhibition of ALDH activity
C: Elimination of PDAC cancer stem cells and tumor recurrence
statement: Disulfiram chelates intracellular copper and inhibits ALDH activity, eliminating PDAC cancer stem cells and preventing tumor recurrence.

B: Generation of reactive oxygen species via iron-dependent endoperoxide bridge cleavage
C: Selective apoptosis of PDAC cells with high transferrin receptor expression
statement: Artemisinin generates ROS via iron-dependent cleavage, selectively inducing apoptosis in PDAC cells with high transferrin receptor expression.

B: Inhibition of ACE leading to reduced angiotensin II and decreased VEGF expression
C: Normalization of tumor vasculature and reduced PDAC angiogenesis
statement: Captopril inhibits ACE, reducing angiotensin II and VEGF expression, which normalizes tumor vasculature and reduces PDAC angiogenesis.

B: Disruption of microtubule polymerization and inhibition of Hedgehog signaling
C: Arrest of PDAC cell cycle and suppression of stromal desmoplasia
statement: Mebendazole disrupts microtubule polymerization and inhibits Hedgehog signaling, arresting the PDAC cell cycle and suppressing stromal desmoplasia.

B: Inhibition of thioredoxin reductase leading to severe oxidative stress
C: Overcoming of gemcitabine resistance in PDAC cells
statement: Auranofin inhibits thioredoxin reductase, inducing severe oxidative stress and overcoming gemcitabine resistance in PDAC cells.

B: Inhibition of STAT5 and blockade of cholesterol uptake via LDLR downregulation
C: Induction of apoptosis and metabolic starvation in PDAC cells
statement: Pimozide inhibits STAT5 and blocks cholesterol uptake via LDLR downregulation, inducing apoptosis and metabolic starvation in PDAC cells.

B: Inhibition of the Hedgehog pathway and blockade of VDAC1-mediated angiogenesis
C: Reduction of PDAC tumor burden and stromal density
statement: Itraconazole inhibits the Hedgehog pathway and blocks VDAC1-mediated angiogenesis, reducing PDAC tumor burden and stromal density.

B: Inhibition of T-type calcium channels and suppression of Akt/mTOR signaling
C: Inhibition of PDAC cell migration and induction of autophagic cell death
statement: Penfluridol inhibits T-type calcium channels and suppresses Akt/mTOR signaling, inhibiting PDAC cell migration and inducing autophagic cell death.

B: Inhibition of the xCT cystine/glutamate antiporter (SLC7A11)
C: Induction of ferroptosis and enhanced radiosensitivity in PDAC
statement: Sulfasalazine inhibits the xCT cystine/glutamate antiporter, inducing ferroptosis and enhancing radiosensitivity in PDAC.
